meta.title: Rootsy — Travel & moving-abroad app in your own language
meta.description: The app for travel and moving abroad: find restaurants, doctors, shops and communities that speak your language, anywhere in the world. Paperwork help, AI assistant and SOS. In 31 languages.
sum.title: Rootsy at a glance
sum.p1: Find restaurants, doctors, shops and communities that speak your language and know your culture.
sum.p2: The community confirms every place: a green pin means at least 3 people confirmed it.
sum.p3: On holiday or moving abroad: a checklist for your first 90 days, an AI assistant and an SOS button.
sum.p4: Free to start, in 31 languages. Alpha version in 2027, beta in 2028–2029, worldwide final version in 2030.
sum.b1: People looking for your language and culture find you, right in your city.
sum.b2: A community-verified profile, featured, with your own statistics.

manifesto.title: 🌍 Beyond borders, never alone.
manifesto.lead: Whether you're planning the move of a lifetime or backpacking on the other side of the world, the challenge is the same: the unknown. A language you don't understand, a lost document, a medical emergency, or just the need for honest advice in a city that isn't yours.
manifesto.claim: Rootsy is your global home in your pocket.
manifesto.body: We built Rootsy because we believe traveling and living abroad should be an adventure, not a bureaucratic nightmare. Whether you stay three days or thirty years: Rootsy gives you the confidence of a local and the technology to solve any setback.
manifesto.p1.d: An AI that speaks your language and the local one, ready to explain how to get a visa or how to ask for an equivalent medicine at the pharmacy.
manifesto.p2.d: Your "Digital Vault" for passports and insurance, with smart alerts and an SOS button for real emergencies.
manifesto.p3.d: Find verified experts and a community of people like you, ready to share advice or a coffee, wherever you are.
manifesto.quote: "You are not a tourist, you are not just an expat. You are a citizen of the world, and Rootsy is your compass."
mapdemo.title: Green pin, yellow pin, red pin. The community decides.
mapdemo.sub: Every place on Rootsy has a color based on user confirmations. If the community says "your language is really spoken here", the pin turns green. No more tourist traps.
mapdemo.l1.d: At least 3 users confirmed your language is spoken here. Safe bet.
mapdemo.l2.d: One or two confirmations. Likely yes, but call ahead to be safe.
mapdemo.l3.d: Nobody confirmed yet. If you go, leave a confirmation for the community!
founder.eyebrow: Born from someone who lived it
founder.name: Hi, I'm David.
founder.text: I moved to Germany, traveled across many countries, and felt firsthand what it means to be alone in front of a bureaucratic form or to look for a doctor who truly understands you. I built Rootsy to make sure no one ever has to feel foreign again.
sos.title: One button for emergencies, anywhere in the world.
sos.text: Local emergency number (112 in EU, 911 in USA, 999 in UK, etc.) + your trusted contacts + GPS location sharing in 1 click. Works offline too.
sos.l1: 📞 Instant call to the correct local number
sos.l2: 📍 GPS location sharing to trusted contacts
sos.l4: 🩺 Pre-built phrase to ask for help at pharmacy/hospital
stories.title: 4 people, 4 ways to use Rootsy.
stories.sub: From a permanent move to a one-week holiday. From a new friend to the doctor who speaks your language.
stories.s1.name: Marco, 32
stories.s1.body: Just moved for work. Uses Rootsy to find a family doctor who speaks Italian, save his rental contract in the Vault, get the AI to explain German forms.
stories.s2.name: Layla, 28
stories.s2.body: Looking for an Arabic-German translator for residency papers. With Coffee Mode meets other Arab women nearby. The AI explains official letters in Arabic.
stories.s3.name: Sarah & Tom, 35
stories.s3.body: Ten days in Rome. Looking for restaurants where English is spoken and an open pharmacy. The community warns them of tourist traps and suggests where locals actually go.
stories.s4.name: Wei, 24
stories.s4.body: Erasmus in Paris. Finds a supermarket with Chinese products, a tribe of Chinese students on Rootsy, and the AI helps fill university forms in French.

gemini.lead: Bureaucracy, languages, deadlines: Google's AI follows you everywhere, in all 31 languages. Fully integrated with the Google world: Calendar, Maps, Gmail, Translate. No more 'I didn't understand what that letter said'.

gemini.free.l2: Explanations of forms and bureaucratic words

aichat.q1: How do I register my residence in Berlin if I don't speak German?
aichat.a1: Step-by-step: 1) I book the Termin at the nearest Bürgeramt for you, 2) I prepare your passport + Wohnungsgeberbestätigung pre-filled, 3) I give you the English translation of the form. Shall I proceed?
aichat.q2: Yes, and tell me which hospital in Berlin has doctors who speak English.
aichat.a2: Charité · Campus Mitte: 4 English-speaking doctors confirmed by the Rootsy community. Opening the map with green pins 🟢
bizx.eyebrow: Why Rootsy works for local businesses
bizx.title: Customers looking for exactly you.
bizx.sub: No more cold ads. People who already speak your language, share your culture, want your food or your service find you. Here's how.
bizx.c1.title: Italian trattoria · Berlin
bizx.c1.body: Authentic Italian trattoria near Schönhauser Allee. Rootsy Business profile with verified "Italian spoken" badge. Result: 47% more bookings from Italians in Germany and Germans who want to practice the language at the table.
bizx.c2.title: Berber Mehmet · Munich
bizx.c2.body: Turkish barber shop in Schwabing. 12 confirmations from the Rootsy community that native türkçe is spoken. Result: Turks just arrived in Munich find him in 30 seconds on the app, before Google Maps.
bizx.c3.title: Dr. Khoury practice · Rome
bizx.c3.body: GP with Arabic-speaking staff. Business profile + SOS integration (Arabic-speaking patients find him via map in emergencies). Result: over 200 new Arabic-speaking patients in 12 months, 89% retention.
bizx.disclaimer: ⚠ Illustrative examples based on business model projections. Real results depend on location, sector, service quality and platform activity.
bizx.faq.title: Local business FAQ
bizx.faq.q1: How much does the Business plan cost?
bizx.faq.a1: 2027 launch starting at €29/month per single location, 30 days free guaranteed. First 50 sign-ups: 6 months free at launch. Multi-site and chains: custom pricing based on number of branches.
bizx.faq.q2: How does the "language spoken" verification work?
bizx.faq.a2: The community confirms. When a Rootsy user visits you and confirms "yes, Italian (or Turkish, Arabic, Chinese…) is really spoken here", your pin turns green after 3+ confirmations. No self-declared: your real customers verify.
bizx.faq.q3: Can I deactivate whenever I want?
bizx.faq.a3: Yes. No annual commitment, no penalty. One-click cancellation from the dashboard. Profile stays visible until end of paid month.
bizx.faq.q4: I'm a chain with 10 locations. How do I manage it?
bizx.faq.a4: Cloud multi-site dashboard: one account for the manager + sub-profiles for each branch. Stats per location, centralized review responses, mass CSV/Google My Business import. Contact us for personalized onboarding.
bizx.cta_text: Ready to get found? Early sign-up: 6 months free at launch + private beta access.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Rootsy is free on "The Traveler" plan. Premium costs €4.99/month (or local equivalent: $7.99 USD, £4.99 GBP, etc.). All new users get Premium free for 14 days.
faq.a2: Yes. The Document Vault uses end-to-end encryption based on your password: not even Rootsy can access your documents. GDPR Art. 9 compliant for sensitive data.
faq.q3: Can I use it just for short trips?
faq.a3: Sure. The free plan is perfect for travelers: find on the map places that speak your language, read community confirmations, use SOS in emergencies. No mandatory signup.
faq.a4: Rootsy is built for the whole world. Alpha version in 2027, beta version in 2028–2029, worldwide final version in 2030.
faq.q5: Does the AI speak my language?
faq.a5: The Premium AI Assistant runs on Google's Gemini: fluent in all 31 supported languages. Explains German forms in Arabic, prepares Italian phone calls, translates letters into Chinese.
faq.a6: Nothing automatic. When the trial ends you go back to the free 'Traveler' plan. To continue Premium, you choose to activate payment.
faq.a7: Yes, anytime from your profile. No commitments, no fees. You keep Premium until the end of the period already paid.
faq.a8: Yes. Rootsy works on browsers (installable PWA), Android and iOS. Same account everywhere, automatic sync.
